bagPolicy.summary: The bag policy for BottleRock Napa Valley allows CamelBak-style water bladder systems that are emptied and transparent for inspection. Other specific items like small blankets and non-professional cameras are also permitted.
allowed: CamelBak-style water bladder systems (emptied and transparent)
bagPolicy.note: Medical representatives may be involved for prescription medications in non-standard containers.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at BottleRock Napa Valley can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in BottleRock Napa Valley's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: BottleRock Napa Valley offers a diverse range of food and drink options, featuring local and renowned chefs, restaurants, and wineries. Attendees can enjoy gourmet dishes, artisanal snacks, and a variety of beverages, including craft beers and fine wines. The festival is known for its culinary stage where celebrity chefs and musicians collaborate for unique cooking demonstrations.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by BottleRock Napa Valley, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in BottleRock Napa Valley's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at BottleRock Napa Valley. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at BottleRock Napa Valley. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
